title: Button
description: shadcn-style button on the react-aria Button primitive. Callers pass intent props (variant, size), never class names. Primary is a glass pane lit from off-center; secondary is extruded like a field; discrete is flat text that washes bloom on hover and sinks when pressed. asChild slots a router Link in place of the button.

anatomy.description: The single root element, a react-aria Button — or, with asChild, the slotted child (a router Link) carrying the same props. Carries data-slot="button", data-variant and data-size for styling hooks and tests.

usage: Use onPress and isDisabled (react-aria semantics), not onClick and disabled.

Variants: primary (default, one per view; the glass pane), secondary (supporting actions; the extruded recipe on bark-50, bloom hairline on hover, inset when pressed), discrete (toolbar and inline triggers; flat at rest, a translucent bloom wash on hover so it reads on any surface, inset when pressed or open). Sizes: mini, small, medium (default).

Navigation wears asChild: <Button asChild variant="discrete"><Link to="/dashboard">Discard</Link></Button> keeps anchor semantics under the button's face. Only the slotted element is styled with :hover/:active; react-aria buttons keep data-hovered/data-pressed.
State styling keys off react-aria data attributes (data-hovered, data-pressed, data-disabled), so hover stays correct across pointer types.
Field sizes (Input, Textarea, Select) mirror these heights, so a field and a button sit on one row at the same size name.
There is no destructive variant yet; when one is added it MUST use the heartwood ramp, the identity's only red.
An icon inside the button is sized by the button; pass it as a child, do not size it yourself.
